name: Manak Online registration
purpose: Create the applicant account on the BIS portal. Every scheme below is applied for from inside this account rather than on a downloaded paper form.

name: Application for grant of licence (Scheme I / ISI mark)
purpose: Apply for a licence to use the ISI mark for one product manufactured to one Indian Standard at one factory address. Filed online with the factory and testing-capability details and the applicable fee.

name: Application for registration (Scheme II / CRS)
purpose: Register an electronics or IT product notified under the Compulsory Registration Scheme. Submitted with a test report from a BIS-recognised laboratory.

name: Application under the Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme
purpose: Apply for an ISI-mark licence for a factory located outside India. Requires a nominated Authorised Indian Representative resident in India.

name: Hallmarking registration for jewellers
purpose: Register a jeweller's premises with BIS so that gold articles can be hallmarked at a recognised Assaying and Hallmarking Centre. Covers the jeweller

name: Renewal of licence
purpose: Renew an existing product certification licence before its expiry date. Lapsing means losing the right to apply the Standard Mark.
